name: Manufact

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: $5 monthly credit, 2 projects, 30k requests/month, 1 team member, 7-day analytics, AUTO region only, scale-to-zero forced. Hard stop: gateway returns 402 when the $5 is used; no overage possible.

plans.name: Hobby yearly
plans.note: $300 billed yearly; $30 monthly credits still reset monthly (annual prepay commitment)

plans.name: Startup yearly
plans.note: $3,000 billed yearly; $300 monthly credits reset monthly (annual prepay commitment)

free.note: Platform credits (YC/partner grants) roll over month to month; plan credits do not.

caveats: Hobby $30/month ($25/month billed yearly, $300/year) with $30 credits; Startup $300/month ($250 yearly, $3,000/year) with $300 credits; Free $0 with $5 credits; Enterprise from $1,000/month. There is NO runtime/CPU/RAM meter. The credit pool (1 credit = $0.01) is drawn by: requests (MCP tools/call only) $0.10 per 1,000; build minutes $0.07/min; bandwidth egress $0.15/GB; eval runs $1; publishing checklist $0.10/run; end-to-end checks $2/run; submission pack $5; managed-chat LLM output $5 per 1M tokens. Rates are the same on every plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

fleet.notes: Manufact Cloud hosts MCP services; Enterprise/BYOC capacity is discussed with team. No numeric new-account managed machine/vCPU/GPU quota, quota-review timing or KYC checklist found. MCP-server/deployment count must not be assumed equivalent to machine count.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

own_agent_api.quote: Run the Vibe agent against the user's sandbox and stream token/tool/status events as SSE.
own_agent_api.note: Only the Vibe prompt-to-MCP-App builder: Manufact's own Vibe agent, driven via /api/v1/vibe/sessions + /vibe/chat/stream (SSE) + /vibe/chat/cancel, operating on an E2B/Vercel sandbox (sandboxProvider). Dashboard-oriented API, agent appears to run server-side against the sandbox; no Claude Code/Codex harness. Not part of MCP hosting itself. Treat as borderline.

ingress_rules.quote: Restrict which IP addresses can reach your server through the gateway, useful for servers that should only be reachable from your own infrastructure.
ingress_rules.note: Gateway-level IP allowlist ('rolling out gradually and may not be visible on your account yet'), per-caller rate limiting, MCP OAuth on the server; single public gateway URL per server, no arbitrary ports.

secret_proxy.quote: Environment variables let you pass secrets and configuration to your server at runtime
secret_proxy.note: Secrets are per-environment env vars injected into the server process (plus build-only secrets). The platform also exposes OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible LLM passthrough endpoints billed to org credits (/api/v1/chat/completions, /responses, /messages), documented for the inspector/managed chat, not as a credential proxy for deployed servers.

image_oci.quote: **Anything else** | a committed `Dockerfile` | your image ... Manufact uses it as-is.
image_oci.note: Builds and deploys from a Dockerfile in your repo (not a pre-built registry image pull).

docker_inside.quote: Manufact is ... a zero-config hosting platform for deploying what you built ... Node.js | Python | Anything else (Dockerfile)
docker_inside.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — each deployment is itself a single built container running an MCP server process; no nested Docker/container runtime is exposed inside it.

nested_virt.quote: Manufact ... The fullstack SDK and cloud platform for building and deploying MCP Apps and MCP Servers
nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — a Git-push MCP server PaaS, no /dev/kvm or VM-in-container capability documented.

desktop.quote: Manufact ... The fullstack SDK and cloud platform for building and deploying MCP Apps and MCP Servers
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no graphical desktop/VNC/RDP product surface exists.

browser.quote: **Public Chat** turns your server into a product anyone can try from a browser, no MCP client required.
browser.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the only browser-related surface is an embeddable chat widget and the dashboard's own test-chat/inspector, not a managed/controllable browser instance.

computer_use.quote: Manufact ... The fullstack SDK and cloud platform for building and deploying MCP Apps and MCP Servers
computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no screenshot/click desktop-driving API.

anti_bot.quote: Manufact ... The fullstack SDK and cloud platform for building and deploying MCP Apps and MCP Servers
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no browser fingerprinting/stealth feature; product hosts MCP servers, not scraping/browser automation.

captcha_solving.quote: Manufact ... The fullstack SDK and cloud platform for building and deploying MCP Apps and MCP Servers
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope.

ssh.quote: **Runtime logs** tab streams runtime output — everything your server writes to stdout and stderr — from the active healthy deployment
ssh.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — access to a deployment is via dashboard/CLI logs and env vars only; no SSH/shell-into-container documented.

snapshot.quote: The pipeline clones your code, analyzes it, builds it, deploys it, and runs health checks before routing traffic to it
snapshot.note: Deployments are rebuilt from git/Dockerfile each time; no disk or memory snapshot/checkpoint feature documented.

snapshot_auto.quote: Prevent Scale to Zero keeps your server warm so clients never hit a cold start.
snapshot_auto.note: Scale-to-zero stops/restarts the process (wake_on_request), but no state snapshot/restore is described — servers are stateless HTTP processes, not VMs with saved memory.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Deployment history: The history table shows every deployment with its MCP URL, source branch and commit, duration, creation time...
snapshot_on_demand.note: No API/CLI snapshot or checkpoint command found; only git-based redeploys.

fork.quote: **Preview**: a specific preview branch. This lets you point preview deployments at staging databases...
fork.note: Branch-based preview deployments exist, but there is no machine-clone/fork API for a running instance.

fork_running.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no live-clone-without-stopping capability documented.

memory_snapshot_fork.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no memory-preserving clone feature; stateless server processes only.

pause_resume.quote: Prevent Scale to Zero keeps your server warm so clients never hit a cold start.
pause_resume.note: Platform has automatic scale-to-zero and wake-on-request, but no documented manual pause/resume control distinct from Start/Stop/Delete deployment management.

persistent_disk.quote: Environment variables let you pass secrets and configuration to your server at runtime, API keys, database URLs, feature flags.
persistent_disk.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — servers are stateless containers; persistence is expected via your own external database reached through env vars, not a platform-provided disk.

volume_attach.quote: Environment variables let you pass secrets and configuration to your server at runtime, API keys, database URLs, feature flags.
volume_attach.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no volume attach feature documented.

volume_shared.quote: Environment variables let you pass secrets and configuration to your server at runtime, API keys, database URLs, feature flags.
volume_shared.note: not offered: outside the product's scope.

live_resize.quote: Prices in USD. Credits reset monthly, including on yearly plans.
live_resize.note: Pricing is credit/usage-metered (no vCPU/RAM sizing selection at all), so there is nothing to live-resize; not offered.

agent_harnesses.quote: Paste this prompt into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or another coding agent — or fetch the same instructions from manufact.com/prompt.md.
agent_harnesses.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Claude Code/Codex/Cursor are named only as external tools a developer pastes a prompt into to build/deploy an MCP server; none run preinstalled inside a Manufact sandbox/template.

harness_api.quote: See the MCP server reference for all 20 tools.
harness_api.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Manufact's own MCP server/API manages deployments and its own 'Vibe' builder agent, not a Claude Code/Codex coding-harness session.

lang_node.quote: **Node.js** | `package.json` (+ a lockfile) | npm, pnpm, yarn, bun

public_ipv4.quote: Once the deployment is healthy, your server is available at its gateway URL, shown in the header of every server page
public_ipv4.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — servers are reached via a shared gateway HTTPS URL/custom domain, not a dedicated public IPv4.

egress_allowlist.quote: Restrict which IP addresses can reach your server through the gateway, useful for servers that should only be reachable from your own infrastructure.
egress_allowlist.note: The documented IP allowlist is inbound (who can reach the server), not an outbound/egress restriction; no egress allowlist or no-internet mode found.

egress_http_rules.quote: Restrict which IP addresses can reach your server through the gateway
egress_http_rules.note: Only inbound gateway IP allowlisting and per-caller rate limiting are documented; no outbound HTTP method/path egress rules.

guest_firewall.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — deployments are managed containers without documented root/VM access, so an in-guest nftables/iptables firewall does not apply (unlike a full VM/microVM).

static_egress_ip.quote: Region: leave on AUTO, or pick US / EU / APAC on the Startup plan and above.
static_egress_ip.note: No fixed/static outbound IP is offered or mentioned; region selection is coarse (US/EU/APAC), not a per-server static IP.

gpu.quote: Manufact ... The fullstack SDK and cloud platform for building and deploying MCP Apps and MCP Servers
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — MCP server hosting has no GPU instance tier.

windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Linux container build/runtime only.

macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope.

self_host.quote: Manufact Cloud — a zero-config hosting platform for deploying what you built. Connect your GitHub repo once; every push auto-deploys.
self_host.note: Manufact Cloud is offered only as managed SaaS; there is no self-hosted distribution of the Cloud platform itself (only the separate open-source mcp-use SDK/client library is self-run).

byoc.quote: Bring your own cloud. Bring your cloud, VPC, and data residency requirements. We'll work with your team to scope a private or dedicated deployment, confirm feasibility, and define operating responsibilities for your environment.

open_source.note: The mcp-use SDK/client library is MIT-licensed open source, but Manufact Cloud (the hosting platform this card prices) is closed-source managed SaaS; the two are distinct per Manufact's own docs ('two tightly linked things').

hipaa.quote: SOC 2 Type II ... Visit our Trust Center for security and compliance documentation. Review SOC 2 Type II and ISO ...
hipaa.note: Trust Center / enterprise page names SOC 2 Type II and (per-request) SSO/data residency, but no HIPAA/BAA mention found anywhere on security, trust, or enterprise pages.

sso.quote: Confirm SSO/SAML availability, audit-log coverage, data residency, and current SOC 2 status with our team during evaluation.
sso.note: Offered on an enterprise/case-by-case basis via sales evaluation, not published as generally available on self-serve plans.

eu_data_residency.quote: Region: leave on `AUTO`, or pick US / EU / APAC on the Startup plan and above.
eu_data_residency.note: EU region selectable on Startup plan and above; also discussed for BYOC/enterprise data-residency requirements.

max_session_h.quote: Prevent Scale to Zero keeps your server warm so clients never hit a cold start.
max_session_h.note: Deployments are long-running server processes with no advertised maximum session/runtime duration; they run continuously (optionally scaling to zero when idle) until stopped/redeployed.
